name: a1-b158-b155
headline: Human Written
windows: Most sober people don't feel much from zeolite, but its effect becomes more obvious when a trip has a toxic or gut-driven component.
I put a spoonful into water--some people need a teaspoon, others a tablespoon--and sip slowly. Rubbing the zeolite on the body or simply holding the jar also helps me.
In my experiments, zeolite has to be prepared correctly. I use powdered zeolite rather than nano-liquid zeolite.
Many products did nothing for me, and quality mattered enormously. Most zeolites have clogged pores because they haven't been cleaned.

name: a1-b156-b157
headline: AI Detected
windows: For my ozonated zeolite, I mix the powder into water and use an ozone-water purifier in a glass vessel because ozone destroys plastic. I mean ozonating water, never inhaling ozone gas.
With a machine producing about two grams of ozone per hour, ten minutes produced a working zeolite for me.
Less time did not work as well, and more time did not noticeably improve it.

I also keep zeolite away from metal during preparation, so I use glass for ozonation and storage whenever possible. Zeolite adsorbs metals (they stick to it), which is part of why it is used for heavy-metal removal, and I don't want it sitting against a metal vessel or utensil before I swallow it.
